svg.title: UBB_CORE2.PKG_ETL_EXPOSURE
svg.desc: Data lineage. pLoan to LOAN_HIST (LOAD_ID filter; L245 lh.LOAD_ID = p_loan_load_id). pColl to LOAN_COLLATERAL_REL_HIST (LOAD_ID filter; L265 lcr.LOAD_ID = p_collateral_load_id). pFx to FX_RATE (LOAD_ID filter; L260 fx.LOAD_ID = p_fx_load_id). pDate to FX_RATE (RATE_DATE filter; L261 fx.RATE_DATE = p_business_date). LOAN to MERGE (LOAN_REF; L206-L208 JOIN LOAN on LOAN_ID, SOURCE_SYSTEM = 'CBS_SIM'). LOAN_HIST to MERGE (source rows; L203-L210 MERGE source reads LOAN_HIST). LOAN_HIST to loan_snapshot (snapshot rows; L237-L246 loan_snapshot reads LOAN_HIST). LOAN_COLLATERAL_REL_HIST to collateral_by_loan (active rows; L256-L266 active allocations of the collateral load). FX_RATE to collateral_by_loan (rates; L259-L264 LEFT JOIN FX_RATE on the currency pair). loan_snapshot to collateral_by_loan (LOAN_ID, currency; L257-L258 JOIN loan_snapshot on LOAN_ID). MERGE to EXPOSURE (new identities; L202-L219 MERGE INTO EXPOSURE, WHEN NOT MATCHED INSERT). EXPOSURE to projection (EXPOSURE_ID; L286-L287 JOIN EXPOSURE on LOAN_ID). loan_snapshot to projection (loan fields; L285 FROM loan_snapshot ls). collateral_by_loan to projection (eligible amount; L288-L289 LEFT JOIN collateral_by_loan on LOAN_ID). projection to EXPOSURE_HIST (INSERT; L223-L236, L269-L284 INSERT INTO EXPOSURE_HIST SELECT). pExp to projection (LOAD_ID value; L270 p_exposure_load_id is selected as LOAD_ID). EXPOSURE_HIST to CTRL_LOAD (row count; L291, L295-L301 UPDATE CTRL_LOAD with the counts).

g.text: Used only by the MERGE source query
source and by the loan_snapshot CTE
Source: LOAN_HIST joined to LOAN on LOAN_ID
WHEN NOT MATCHED: insert a new identity
LEFT JOIN FX_RATE on allocation currency -> loan
currency, load, business date and rate type
Columns inserted by the MERGE: EXPOSURE_ID,
Read back by the projection on LOAN_ID
JOIN EXPOSURE e ON e.LOAN_ID = ls.LOAN_ID
Rows: loan_snapshot joined to EXPOSURE on LOAN_ID
Pre-write validations (raise before any row is written)
-20400 p_business_date is NULL or not at midnight
-20401 loan, collateral and FX load: not one VALIDATED/COMPLETED load for the business date; the loan load must also be CBS_SIM / LOAN
-20402 output load is not one STARTED INTERNAL / DERIVED_EXPOSURE load for the business date
-20403 the output load already has EXPOSURE_HIST rows
-20404 an active allocation has a NULL amount or currency
-20405 an active allocation's LOAN_ID is not in the loan snapshot
-20406 an active allocation currency pair differing from the loan currency has no direct ECB rate in FX_RATE
-20407 the CTRL_LOAD update did not change exactly one STARTED row
The package never COMMITs or ROLLBACKs.
Fixture assumptions and unresolved rules (not approved business policy)
Candidate assumptions named in the package header: CCF 50%; ECB direct rates for the business date; ALLOCATED_VALUE_AMT already eligible after allocation and haircuts;
all three input load IDs refer to the requested business date; the caller resolves the authoritative collateral and FX load IDs; all loans of the chosen LOAN_HIST snapshot are included.
Source system and dataset of the collateral and FX loads are not established by the package; they must be confirmed from the operating process.
The header comments describe the scheduler creating the STARTED output load and the caller committing or rolling back; the package body implements none of that.
